title: hazel-jit’s PR, Described
blurb: A working draft of the description for hazelgrove/hazel#2859, hazel-jit for dev, to iterate on before it goes on GitHub: an executive summary for whoever decides, an engineering summary for whoever reviews, then the details. Every evaluator test also runs compiled where it compiles: 234 of 289 do, and none differs from the interpreter. Beside ReScript, Melange and js_of_ocaml, hazel-jit now lays out records as they do, as plain objects. On a trial made the same day, its tail calls are loops and its named functions take their tuple's parts as JS arguments: the games take 0.70 of the jit's time, every answer the same. Options and constructors are still its own, and the other compilers' speed on the games is still to measure.
source: 065/pr-2859.md: the description for hazelgrove/hazel#2859, in GitHub's Markdown; the page renders it and carries it to copy
